data.doc: One checked Respo event boundary: legacy anonymous enums normalize to typed Reel controls or nominal application Actions. Dynamic remains only because Respo render! owns an open dispatcher contract; business updater/store are concrete.
Application fields are concrete. Only the Respo component-state tree retains its existing heterogeneous payload contract; hydrate and updates must pass a runtime decoder.
